settings.merchantModeDesc: Accept QR payments at a counter. Data stays encrypted on this device.

settings.merchantLabelDesc: Shown to customers on the payment request before they approve.
settings.merchantZeroConfThresholdDesc: Payments at or below this amount are accepted as soon as they're seen on the network, before being confirmed in a block — faster checkout, but with a brief window of double-spend risk. Keep this low for everyday counter sales.
settings.merchantRequiredConfirmationsDesc: How many blocks must confirm a payment above the instant-accept limit before it counts as paid. More confirmations are safer against a blockchain reorganization, but make the customer wait longer at checkout.
settings.dexModeDesc: Adds an optional BSC (EVM) account derived from this wallet's recovery phrase, for swapping on PancakeSwap. Off by default — no network calls until enabled.
settings.slippageDesc: How much the price can move against you before a swap reverts. Higher tolerance means swaps succeed more often but you may get a worse price.
settings.txDeadlineDesc: How long a swap can stay pending before it's rejected by the router.

agreement.blockchain: All transactions are executed directly on blockchain networks. Once confirmed, transactions are irreversible. Network fees, delays, or failures are determined by the blockchain and are outside of Navio's control.
agreement.liability: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Navio Go Wallet shall not be liable for any loss of funds, data, profits, or damages arising from the use or inability to use the application, including but not limited to user error, device compromise, or third-party failures.

receiptVerify.title: Verify Receipt
receiptVerify.intro: Check a payment receipt's signature and see who issued it. This works even if Employer mode is off — it's built for recipients, not just employers.
receiptVerify.pastePlaceholder: Paste the contents of a navio-receipt-*.json file here
receiptVerify.verdictValidDesc: The signature and the issuer's public key were verified against this receipt's contents. The on-chain amount is NOT verified by this receipt — this only confirms who signed it and that it hasn't been altered since.
receiptVerify.verdictInvalidDesc: This receipt's signature does not match its contents or claimed issuer key. It may have been altered, corrupted, or is not a genuine receipt. Don't rely on any of the details below.
receiptVerify.fingerprintNote: Compare this against a fingerprint the issuer shared with you directly (not through this receipt) before trusting it.
receiptVerify.trustUnknown: You haven't seen a key for this issuer label before.
receiptVerify.trustTrusted: Matches a key you've already trusted for "{label}".
receiptVerify.trustChanged: Warning: "{label}" previously signed with a different key. This could be a legitimate key rotation — or someone else signing as this issuer. Confirm with the issuer through another channel before trusting it.
receiptVerify.trustCheckUnavailable: Load a wallet to check this against previously trusted issuer keys.
